title: soliva anthemifolia
intro: Soliva anthemifolia, commonly known as the soliva or anthemis, is a type of flowering plant in the daisy family. The health benefits of Soliva anthemifolia include its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to alleviate various health issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to calm the nervous system and reduce anxiety, as well as its potential to treat digestive issues due to its antispasmodic properties. The bioactive constituents of Soliva anthemifolia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
